items.title: Delimitation: CM Vijay writes to PM Modi, urges freeze on Lok Sabha seats at 543
items.summary: Follow TNM’s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi on August 13, urging the Union government to permanently freeze the Lok Sabha’s strength at 543 and retain the existing distribution of seats among states and Union Territories. In his letter, the Chief Minister pointed out the resolution adopted by the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly on August 12, which called for constitutional amendments to preserve the existing level of representation for states. “The existing number of Lok Sabha seats allocated to the states should be made permanent at the current level. Current distribution of seats among the states must be maintained. I kindly request you to consider the resolution passed by Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and bring necessary Constitutional amendments in this regard,” Vijay said in his letter. The Assembly resolution also sought the implementation of 33% reservation for women in the 2029 Lok Sabha without changing the existing strength of 543. items.title: Litigant in Kerala attacks parents of lawyers who represented his wife
items.summary: Parents of two lawyer-siblings in Kerala were attacked by a litigant on Thursday night as retaliation for appearing against him in a case filed by his wife. According to a first information report lodged by the police, two men attacked the parents. The FIR was registered based on a complaint filed by the advocates' 79-year-old mother from the hospital where she was being treated after the attack. Her 80-year-old husband, the advocates' father, was stabbed repeatedly and he remains in critical condition. According to the FIR, the advocates represented the wife of one of the attackers who sought police protection from him due to domestic dispute. At around 5:30 pm on August 13, two men, including the irate litigant, forcefully entered the house of the advocate's parents and asked them where their son was. According to the FIR, the men were armed with knives and threatened to kill the advocates and their parents. When the advocates' mother asked them to leave, the attackers dragged the father out of the house, threw him on the ground, attempted to slit his throat and repeatedly stabbed him in the torso.
